components.name: Labeled field
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted,#526273)}.ds-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #aebac7;border-radius:6px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#172b3a)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#2457c5);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dde4eb);overflow:auto}.ds-nav button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;border:0;background:none;padding:12px 0;color:var(--muted,#526273);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:var(--blue,#2457c5);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--blue,#2457c5);font-weight:600}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#edf2f8}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#2457c5);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Evidence surface
components.html:
Statement evidence

Source records and period averages.

narrative.overview: A restrained light workspace makes statement evidence easy to inspect. Clear numbers, quiet surfaces and familiar controls support repeat use; blue usage, gray comparisons and amber weather preserve consistent meaning.

rules.name: The Series Meaning Rule
rules.body: Keep color meaning consistent across chart, legend and readout.

dos: Do keep current usage blue, prior comparisons gray and weather amber.
Do use tabular numbers, visible units and explicit missing-data states.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and preserve chart scrolling on narrow screens.
donts: Don't imply measured daily electricity or appliance causation through chart styling.
Don't hide provenance or incomplete coverage behind visual polish.
